thread:
ryan_sales: Heads up — Slate (POC) wants to move forward but needs a quick model fit check. They want to serve a customer-adapted variant (slate-13b-adv) with 4-bit quant + KV cache + function-calling. Also asking for Private VPC + KMS. Any immediate compatibility or perf blockers? cc @mira_se :eyes:

mira_se: Quick questions — is the variant LoRA+quant, or full-quantized checkpoint? do they expect >2048 seq?

ryan_sales: It's a full-quantized checkpoint provided by partner; they said seq typically 4096 for retrieval-augmented prompts. No LoRA.

mira_se: 4096 changes a lot. need to know KV cache size, memory budget for Dedicated, and if function-calling uses structured embeddings. Can someone from runtime confirm KV layout support for 4-bit quant at 4k?

Dan_eng_runtime: dan_eng_runtime: I can run a quick compat probe. main concerns: 4-bit quant math kernels and causal cache addressing when seq > 2048. We support 4-bit quant generally but need to validate kernel path for this architecture + attention implementation. sending smoke test next.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: quickcheck job queued (#6012) — will report back in ~15m.

sara_eng_ml: sara_eng_ml: FYI quantized tokenization edgecases can cause hallucinated EOS if tokenizer mismatch. ask Slate for model tokenizer file and sample prompts. also want a small eval set (5 inputs) to sanity-check quality after quant.

ryan_sales: I'll ping them; requesting tokenizer + 5 sample prompts and expected outputs. Also they want pricing: trial Dedicated for 2 weeks — what ballpark do we offer for 1x A100-equivalent pool? cc @olivia_pricing

olivia_pricing: olivia_pricing: For a short 2-week Dedicated trial with 1 reserved GPU-equivalent, we usually give a discounted pilot rate. ballpark $6k-$9k depending on burst capacity and SLO. need to know expected token throughput and peak RPS to finalize.

mira_se: back to compatibility — function-calling: does the model variant include special BOS/JSON-steering tokens? Slate mentioned a structured tool schema. If model tokenization shifts with quant, function output could break.

lee_security: lee_security: On security — they require VPC + KMS + SOC2 contract. We support customer-managed KMS for Private. request: send us their security questionnaire (NDA signed?) so we can map controls. Also confirm data residency (region).

ryan_sales: They signed NDA last week. region: eu-west-1 for production, but POC can be in us-west for speed. KMS: customer-managed preferred.

Dan_eng_runtime: dan_eng_runtime: Running smoke now. sample cmd I'm using (will paste logs):

```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-runtime/smoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' -d '{"model":"slate-13b-adv-4bit","sequence":512,"prompt":"Summarize: The model performed...","max_tokens":64}'
```

Dan_eng_runtime: log snapshot: 

```
[INFO] loading weights -> quant kernel path ok
[WARN] kv_cache reserved for 4096 seq -> paging enabled
[ERROR] function-call token mapping mismatch on sample #2
```

Dan_eng_runtime: initial take — kernel loads, but function-calling tokens don't align with tokenizer used by their wrapper. need the actual tokenizer.json and vocab.bin from partner. KV paging will increase latency; we should estimate p99 impact.

sara_eng_ml: sara_eng_ml: If KV paging kicks in p99 could jump 2-3x. for POC we can live with that if customer accepts degraded latency. Suggest we provision burst capacity and enable prefix cache to reduce cold misses.

olivia_pricing: olivia_pricing: add note — burst capacity costs extra. I'll include a line item for burst GPUs and a clause that final pricing adjusts if seq distribution stays at 4k.

ryan_sales: Action items: 1) I will request tokenizer files + 5 eval prompts + expected outputs from Slate. 2) Mira/Dan to confirm if function-calling can be remapped or if we need partner to re-tokenize. 3) Lee to start security Q mapping. 4) Olivia draft pilot quote with burst item.

mira_se: Also need to confirm whether the variant uses any custom CUDA ops — partner mentioned a patched attention kernel. if so, we may need eng-ml to recompile kernels for Private.

sara_eng_ml: sara_eng_ml: If they require patched kernel we can do it but it's a non-trivial engineering effort; need to scope (1-2 sprints) unless partner shares compatible binary. For POC we can try a fallback attention kernel with performance cost.

lee_security: lee_security: send the security questionnaire to me (prefer Google Drive link). I'll map to our control matrix and flag any gaps for Private deployment.

ryan_sales: Slate replied — attaching (they pasted a link): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/tokenizer_and_samples.zip

mira_se: downloading and running quick token check.

Dan_eng_runtime: quick result: tokenizer looks compatible, but they used an extra special token <CALL_START> which is token id 50256 in their vocab. We remap but need partner to confirm function-call framing.

sara_eng_ml: sara_eng_ml: run these 5 evals through quantized path and non-quant to compare diffs. small script below:

```python
# pseudo
for input in evals:
  out_fp = run_model(input, model='slate-13b-adv-fp32')
  out_q = run_model(input, model='slate-13b-adv-4bit')
  print(diff_metrics(out_fp, out_q))
```

# expect small BLEU/ROUGE shifts; flag >5% quality regression

Dan_eng_runtime: smoke test completed. p50 latency ok, p99 ~2.8x when seq>2048 and KV paging occurs. function-calling mapping resolved with remap table but we need partner signoff.

olivia_pricing: olivia_pricing: I'll put a provisional price $7,500 for 2-week pilot + optional burst at $1,200/day. include note: additional eng effort for custom kernel or recompile billed separately.

lee_security: lee_security: received their questionnaire. quick hits: they want key rotation policy evidence, iso docs, and an app-level data deletion SLA. We'll need engineering to sign off on KMS integration design for Private.

ryan_sales: Thanks everyone. I'll push checklist to Slate and ask them to confirm acceptance of temporary latency hit for POC. Will loop back once they upload tokenizer + sign off on remap. :thumbsup:

mira_se: keep me posted — if they accept latency we can proceed with pilot in us-west. If they insist EU for POC, we need to re-evaluate slot availability and latency impact.

ryan_sales: noted. end of thread for now.
